overview: You conned Gaunt with half a mouth and a clove, before Gilbert came up. You said the throne, this England, and the turn into shame and rotten parchment bonds. You did not add a coast the roll does not have.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Conned the speech alone, on the right side of the mouth.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Rehearsed Gaunt with half a mouth

summary: Rehearsed Gaunt with half a mouth
